name: banggood_dropship-mcp
description: Banggood Dropship Center (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, quote_shipping, get_

platform_mcp_banggood_dropship_app_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BANGGOOD_DROPSHIP_APP_ID
platform_mcp_banggood_dropship_app_id.description: app_id issued by the Banggood Open Platform (https://api.banggood.com, Manager Center) after the partner application is approved; calls must come from the registered IP address.

platform_mcp_banggood_dropship_app_secre.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BANGGOOD_DROPSHIP_APP_SECRET
platform_mcp_banggood_dropship_app_secre.description: The app_secret. GET /getAccessToken?app_id=&app_secret= returns an access_token valid 2 hours, sent as the access_token query parameter and renewed automatically.

platform_mcp_banggood_dropship_warehouse.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BANGGOOD_DROPSHIP_WAREHOUSE
platform_mcp_banggood_dropship_warehouse.description: Banggood warehouse code for quote_shipping (the `warehouse` of GetProductInfo's warehouse_list, e.g. CN, US, UK); the API rejects the call (12031) when it is missing.

platform_mcp_banggood_dropship_currency.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BANGGOOD_DROPSHIP_CURRENCY
platform_mcp_banggood_dropship_currency.description: Currency for prices and shipping fees (e.g. USD); Banggood uses USD when unset.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe obtains a token and reads the country list ({code: 0, countries[{country_id, country_name}]}), so `account` holds that list.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /product/getProductList: `category` (cat_id, a SUB-category id from GetCategoryList) is required by Banggood (12021 otherwise); `query` is not accepted. Pages hold at most 20 products; prices come from get_product (warehouse_list) and not from the list.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /product/getProductInfo?product_id=: {product_name, weight (kg), poa_list[{option_name, option_values[{poa_id, poa_name, poa_price}]}], warehouse_list[{warehouse, warehouse_price}], image_list, description}. `price` is the first warehouse's price; the response does not echo the product id, so `id` is empty and the requested id is the product. Pass poa_id and warehouse from here to orders.

tools.name: quote_shipping
tools.description: GET /product/getShipments: `country` is Banggood's English country NAME (e.g. United States, see GetCountries), not an ISO code; the warehouse comes from the `warehouse` setting. Products with attribute options also need a poa_id, which the vocabulary cannot pass (the API then answers 12033).

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /order/getOrderInfo?sale_record_id= (YOUR order reference used when the order was imported): the first Banggood order under it {order_id, status, currency, total_amount, sub_amount, shipfee, product_list}; amounts are decimal strings, so they are returned as total_amount rather than the numeric `total`. `id` in the result is Banggood's order_id, which track takes.

tools.name: track
tools.description: GET /order/getTrackInfo?order_id= (Banggood order_id from get_order): track_info[{event, time (UTC)}], latest and historical events.
